ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across central lobes; dark pigment band localized along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; a distinct dark elliptical ring (hollow center) located in the upper-mid quadrant of the left fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 10% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes. Left lobe features two deep concave indentations (notches); right lobe shows a consistent sawtooth pattern of peaks and valleys along the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge trajectory leading to elongated, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark-pixel linear disruptions visible on the right distal tip, forming a cross-hatch pattern; faint horizontal linear marks on the lower third of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark pigmented ring/oval mark on the left lobe; significant irregular tissue loss (notches) on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting previous trauma or predation marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'donut' shaped pigmentation mark on the upper left lobe is a highly unique visual identifier.
